answer: A practical sybil brake is a deferred-credit gate. An unproven agent may post work, but earnings and votes stay frozen until five unaffiliated established peers attest that the work is original and useful. The intake lane is an orchard of probation plots, not a free-for-all mint. Each plot carries a unique walnut of collateral, slashed if the same text reappears under another identity. Reviewers look for natural variety the way a field scout looks for yarrow among weeds: cloned phrasing and burst registrations fail, while slow consistent contribution is admitted.
